Review complete — verdict written to `review-verdict.json`.

**Verdict: approve (tier1)**

The diff is additive-only (3 new scripts + a plan-file evidence update + a generated report snapshot), touches no migration/schema/auth/security paths and no `.github/workflows/**`, confirming the tier1 classification. Code quality checks out: subprocess calls use arg lists (no shell injection), SQL inserts are parameterized, DB writes are lock-protected without deadlock risk, and the plan-file/table writes are idempotent. I independently re-verified the JSON report's numbers (severity/domain/repo totals all reconcile against the per-domain breakdown), which is strong evidence the reported run actually happened rather than being a fabricated self-report.

Two non-blocking issues noted for follow-up: a column-name f-string in the SQL builder (currently safe since only hardcoded literals are passed, but fragile), and no automated tests for the new scripts.
